title: Moss and the Cool Pool
note: b414 — Phase 3, oa, oo (long and short oo) added.

pages.brief: Moss the hedgehog standing in bright sunshine, looking warm.
Moss spotting a round stone pool of water on top of a low grey wall.
Moss the hedgehog sipping water from the stone pool, looking refreshed.
A orange-red fox approaching the stone pool on the wall from the other side.
Moss the hedgehog and the fox both sipping water from the stone pool together.
A white goat approaching the stone pool from the grass below.
Moss, the fox and the goat all sipping water together from the stone pool.
Several different small animals gathered round the stone pool on the wall, all drinking together.
